blocks.content: In the previous lesson, you built the full HTML structure for the hero section. Now it's time to style it so it starts matching the Figma design.
In this lesson, you'll focus on:

items: laying out the text and image side by side

blocks.content: You're not adding interactions or responsiveness yet. The goal is to match the static desktop design first. Once that foundation looks right, the rest becomes much easier to build on.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
